text: Coffee with Ethan. He's still living in Leeds but moved to the other side of town. Works at the council now, planning dept. His sister Rebecca has two kids, both at the same primary.

spans.text: moved to the other side of town

text: Carmen's gone vegan since summer, properly strict, no honey even. Her partner Aidan still eats everything. They're hosting dinner Saturday and she's nervous about feeding his parents. Remind me to bring something without dairy. She has also stopped drinking, and Aidan's dad is diabetic so pudding needs thinking about. Aidan says just bring wine for his mum, she likes a dry white.

Long call with Karim. Arsenal season ticket renewed again, he's been going since he was nine with his dad. His dad's knee op is sometime next week so he'll miss the derby. Should text Karim on Friday to see how the op went. He's also got into darts, plays in a pub league on Tuesdays, and reckons he'll win the cup over the summer.
Imani is knitting a blanket for her niece, been at it since early March. Says she's only halfway. Also joined a book club at the library, they're doing Middlemarch which she hates.
Naledi lives in Woodstock now, near the old brewery. Works remote for a Dutch logistics firm. Her mum lives with them since her dad passed. Has a son, Mandla, he's 14.

spans.text: Works remote for a Dutch logistics firm

text: Bumped into Delroy and Alina at the market. Their wedding was meant to be end of the month but it's off, they've split. Delroy seemed OK, Alina didn't say much. Leave it a week then check in on Alina.
Vikram coeliac, Shreya his wife allergic to shellfish. Note for when they come round.
Need to book the boiler service before the end of the month and sort the car MOT. Also dentist sometime next week.

spans.text: before the end of the month

text: Chatted to Mehmet after the match. He plays bass in a covers band, mostly 90s Britpop. They've got a gig at the Crown next Thursday. Anika (his girlfriend) says he's been practising every night. Don't forget to ask Mehmet how the gig went. Mehmet's also learning Turkish saz from his uncle, wants to work some of it into the set eventually.

spans.text: ask Mehmet how the gig went

text: Felix is massively into chess now, plays online every evening, rating around 1600. His brother Oliver got him into it. Felix's birthday is in a fortnight and he's been dropping hints about a proper wooden board.

spans.text: dropping hints about a proper wooden board

text: Agnieszka's flying to Krakow tomorrow for her grandmother's 90th. Back Tuesday. Her husband's staying home with the dog, Bruno.
Niamh and Matteo had the baby! Little girl, born Sunday. Must send flowers this week.

Lunch with Nikolai. He doesn't drink anymore, two years sober as of this weekend. Only drinks sparkling water with lime. Lives in Hackney, works as a sound engineer at a studio near Old Street. Dating someone called Eva but early days. He's into vinyl too, mostly jazz, and is building a record room in the loft over the next few months.

spans.text: Only drinks sparkling water with lime
works as a sound engineer at a studio
building a record room in the loft

text: Adriana mentioned she's struggling with the new manager at work, thinking about leaving over the summer. She's a nurse at St Thomas's, been there eight years. I should call her next week.
Rohan's half marathon is Sunday. He's really nervous, calf has been playing up. Text him good luck Saturday night.
Dorota supports Legia Warsaw, her whole family does. Her uncle used to play for their youth team apparently. She also does pottery on Wednesdays.

spans.text: used to play for their youth team

text: Shopping list: oat milk, lentils, coriander, bin bags. Pick up dry cleaning Thursday.

spans.text: oat milk, lentils, coriander, bin bags

text: Hoang Wang called. He and his wife Olga are moving to Bristol early March, she got a transfer. Their kids will start at a new school after Easter. Hoang's a bit stressed about selling the flat. Remind me to offer help with packing. Olga's mum lives near Clifton already so that helps. The kids are 7 and 10 and the older one plays violin.
Eamon hates coriander, says it tastes like soap. Also no mushrooms. Loves a Guinness though, only draught.
Caught up with Chantal over brunch. She's finally finished her PhD viva, passed with minor corrections! Graduation is sometime in July. Her mum's flying over from Martinique for it.

Adebayo works for Shell in Aberdeen, been there about six years. Lives with his partner Rachel and their cat, Pepper. Rachel teaches primary. Adebayo plays five-a-side Thursdays and supports Man United, which Rachel can't stand. Rachel is gluten free and won't touch beer.
Called Ethan back. His dad's in hospital again, heart thing, tests on Monday. He's worried. Ring Ethan Monday evening.
Karim's sister Imani is getting married next spring, engagement party is this weekend. I'm going with Carmen. Need to get a card.
Rebecca Schmidt from work: vegetarian, no nuts (serious allergy, carries an EpiPen). Loves oolong tea. Lives in Ealing with her husband and three kids.
Mandla got into the regional rugby squad! Trials were last Tuesday. Naledi is over the moon. First training session is next Wednesday.

spans.text: got into the regional rugby squad

text: Book club cancelled tomorrow, Aidan's ill. Rescheduled for sometime next week.
Vikram Shah's mum turning 70 on the 14th, family's doing a big lunch. He wants to get her a sari but doesn't know where to start. Ask Shreya for ideas.

spans.text: wants to get her a sari

text: Long catch-up with Alina over wine. She's doing an evening course in illustration, finishes end of November, then an exhibition with the class in early December. Her brother Nikolai is coming over from Riga for it. She says she's mostly drawing birds at the moment, been obsessed since a trip to Norfolk over the summer. Also she's off gluten for now, doctor's suggestion, waiting on blood test results which come back Friday. Should message her after Friday to see what they said.
Matteo's restaurant is doing a tasting menu this Friday, all Ligurian. He says Niamh's doing front of house. I'm taking Eva.
Felix and his partner Anika live in a canal boat now, moored in Little Venice. Anika works at the British Library, rare books. Felix freelances.
Mehmet's grandad died last week. Funeral is Thursday in Izmir, he's flying out tomorrow. Send him a message tonight.
Spoke to Eamon, he's finally retiring end of the month after 32 years at the post office. Leaving do is Friday at the Swan. Chip in for the present.
Shreya's into bouldering, goes three times a week. Her climbing partner Rohan is the guy who works at the bike shop on Mill Road. They're both vegetarian.
Dorota's dog Fifi is having an operation on her hip Monday. Dorota is in bits about it. Check in with her Tuesday.
Run 5k three times this week. Meal prep Sunday.
Quick one: Adriana's driving test is next Tuesday. Third attempt. She's terrified. Wish her luck Monday.
Oliver plays the cello in a community orchestra, they rehearse Thursdays. Concert is early March, Elgar. His girlfriend Hoang is a violinist in the same orchestra, that's how they met.

Delroy's cooking a jerk chicken thing for the whole street on Saturday, it's his annual one. His mum Mrs Williams is coming down from Birmingham. He's asked everyone to bring drinks, he likes Red Stripe.
Carmen said her brother Ethan has moved in with them temporarily, between jobs. He's applying for a teaching post. Interview is next Friday. Remind me to ask Carmen how Ethan's interview went.

spans.text: ask Carmen how Ethan's interview went

text: Agnieszka knits, crochets, does everything with yarn. Has a stall at the craft fair over Christmas. Her daughter Eva does the online shop. Karim says they're thinking of moving out of the flat before the baby, maybe end of the month they'll start viewing places. I should get them something for the baby, maybe a sling.

spans.text: get them something for the baby

text: Rachel Kaur is pregnant, due early March! Second one. Her husband Karim's over the moon. She's had awful morning sickness though.
Talked to Naledi about her trip. She went to Lisbon with her sister in the summer, loved it. Thinking of going back next year with her mum. She doesn't eat pork, I keep forgetting.
Saw Imani yesterday. Her housewarming is this Saturday, new place in Peckham. She and her boyfriend Felix finally bought somewhere. Bring a plant.
Matteo's mum is in hospital for a hip replacement, sometime early next week. He's going to Turin to be with her. His dad is not coping. Call Matteo when he's back.
Olga's son Aidan just started at uni in Glasgow, studying architecture. She misses him a lot. Should check how he's settling in when I see her next month.

spans.text: when I see her next month

text: Vikram said the cricket club's annual dinner is called off this year, not enough people. He's gutted, he's the treasurer.
Chat with Nikolai at the gym. He supports Zenit, watches every game on a dodgy stream. Plays FIFA with his nephew on Sundays. Also does a bit of woodwork, built his own bookshelves.
Rohan's birthday is next Saturday, 30th. Shreya's organising a surprise dinner at that Nepali place. He's mad about Liverpool, a retro shirt would go down well. Remind me to order it by Wednesday.

spans.text: surprise dinner at that Nepali place
retro shirt would go down well

text: Mandla's mum Naledi said he's being bullied at school. He's not sleeping well. She's going in to speak to the head tomorrow. I should check in with Naledi after.
Adebayo and Rachel are celebrating their tenth anniversary in a fortnight, going to Rome for a long weekend. She wants to see the Vatican, he just wants pasta.
Hoang is lactose intolerant but loves cheese anyway, takes the tablets. Drinks oat flat whites. Lives in Manchester with three housemates.

spans.text: Lives in Manchester with three housemates

text: Eva Moreau has her first art exhibition opening Thursday evening at a little gallery in Brixton. She's paired up with her friend Chantal. Both really anxious about it. Go along and take flowers. He's been with the firm eleven years. Alina says he's not sleeping. Ring him at the weekend too.

Delroy got made redundant on Monday. They gave him two weeks notice. He's job hunting, mostly logistics roles. His wife Alina is supportive but worried about the mortgage. Need to send him the recruiter contact.
Oliver lives just off Gloucester Road, works in insurance, very dull he says. Has a twin brother Felix who's a vet. Their mum is from Cork.
Carmen Suzuki's daughter has her first ballet recital Saturday afternoon. Carmen's more nervous than the kid. Also Carmen's started a sourdough phase, brought me a loaf.
Phoned Mehmet to see how the gig went. Packed out, they've been asked back for New Year's Eve. Next rehearsal Monday.
Rachel loves crime novels, especially anything Scandinavian. She's reading her way through Jo Nesbo. Also a massive Taylor Swift fan, went to three Eras shows.
Note to self: renew passport before the summer, and cancel the gym membership end of the month.

Aidan's new job starts next Monday, he's head chef at a gastropub in Clapham. Super excited. Mehmet Usman used to work there. Remind me to text Aidan on Monday morning, good luck. His sister Chantal Moreau ran a restaurant there for years and is lending him her knives.

spans.text: ran a restaurant there for years

text: Long chat with Eamon and his wife. Their son Rohan is off to Australia over the summer for a gap year, working on a farm near Perth. They're both a bit anxious. Eamon's been learning to cook Indian food in the meantime, does a decent dal. His wife is allergic to peanuts so everything is nut free. He's also getting back into golf, plays Saturday mornings with his brother. Ask Eamon how the golf's going next time.

spans.text: Ask Eamon how the golf's going
